anchors.exact_quote: have introduced a modified design of the cooling jacket on the cylinder cover in order to improve cooling water circu - lation. In order to do so, the previous radial cooling water inlet has been changed to a more “tangential” inlet in order to create a forced water rotation and hereby pull out more of the foreign particles from the cooling water space and preventing deposits and creating a more uniform cooling of the entire circumference of the cylinder cover.
